title: Books of Prime Entry
author: DkfTkX7xNnbzLCF2p
chapter_outcomes: Understand the principles of the double entry system to record business transactions
Understand the role of books of prime entry in the recording of business transactions
Have knowledge of preparation of ledger accounts
Comprehend the purpose of a trial balance
Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of maintaining full accounting records

Have clarity on the accounting concepts underpinning the preparation of accounts: business entity, historic cost, money measurement, going concern, consistency, prudence, realisation, duality, materiality, objectivity, matching /accruals and substance over form
Understand the use of computerised accounting systems in recording financial transactions
Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of introducing a computerised accounting system
Understand the ways in which the security of data can be ensured within a computerised accounting system
